tools.name: search_addons
tools.description: Search the fsaircraft.net catalog of payware Microsoft Flight Simulator add-ons (aircraft, scenery, liveries, utilities) across every tracked store. Returns the cheapest live offer for each add-on with its discount and MSFS 2020/2024 compatibility as declared by the selling store.

tools.name: get_addon
tools.description: Everything the catalog holds on a single add-on: description, developer, declared simulator compatibility, rating, every store offer with its VAT split and sale expiry, the lowest price ever recorded, and the real-world aircraft types and airports it implements.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: Add-ons discounted right now, deepest discount first. A discount here means the current price is below the highest price we have ever recorded for that same offer at that same store — never a store-printed list price, so permanent markdowns do not appear.

tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Every store offer for one add-on, in-stock offers with known net prices first, ordered by net EUR price. Includes the listed price, tax status, known net price, EUR conversion, stock, sale expiry and an outbound link.

tools.name: price_history
tools.description: Daily lowest known VAT-excluded price in EUR, using current exchange rates, plus min/max/current and whether it is at its lowest ever. Answers "has this ever been cheaper than X?".

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Every storefront in the catalog, with how many add-ons we track there, how many are discounted right now, and whether its prices include VAT. Use it to answer "which stores do you actually cover" and to get the `store` slug vocabulary for search_addons.

tools.name: list_developers
tools.description: Add-on studios in the catalog, busiest first, optionally filtered by name.

tools.name: find_aircraft_type
tools.description: Resolve a plain-language aircraft name ("737 MAX", "Cessna 172", "A320neo") to its ICAO Doc 8643 designator, with how many add-ons we carry for it. Feed the designator to list_addons_for_aircraft.

tools.name: list_addons_for_aircraft
tools.description: Every add-on implementing one real-world aircraft type, across all studios, cheapest first. The type link is our own classification (from the title and the store metadata), not the store's.

tools.name: list_sceneries_for_airport
tools.description: Every add-on scenery we carry for one airport, by ICAO (or IATA) code, cheapest first.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the fsaircraft.net MSFS add-on catalog and return documents in the shape ChatGPT deep-research and company-knowledge connectors expect. `id` is the add-on slug; pass it to `fetch`. Prefer search_addons when filters or prices matter.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Retrieve one add-on as a document, by the `id` returned from `search` (the add-on slug). Returns the full description plus every current store price.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Every store offer for one add-on, cheapest first, with the gross price in the store currency, the VAT-excluded net price where the rate is known, the EUR conversion, stock, sale expiry and an outbound link. This is the question the website cannot answer in one shot." → after: "Every store offer for one add-on, in-stock offers with known net prices first, ordered by net EUR price. Includes the listed price, tax status, known net price, EUR conversion, stock, sale expiry and an outbound link."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "price_history" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Daily cheapest recorded price for one add-on across all its offers, plus min/max/current and whether it is at its lowest ever. Answers "has this ever been cheaper than X?"." → after: "Daily lowest known VAT-excluded price in EUR, using current exchange rates, plus min/max/current and whether it is at its lowest ever. Answers "has this ever been cheaper than X?"."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
